body.condition: For a fixed constant \(c_{\mathrm{loc}}\in(0,1]\), every local signal block satisfies \(\sigma_r(M^{it})\ge c_{\mathrm{loc}}\psi\) for \((i,t)\in G\times W\).

novel.justification: A fixed local-to-global signal ratio holds when donor and pretreatment restrictions retain nonvanishing factor mass; balanced common-start panels with bounded positive loadings, including the displayed alternating-factor calibration, satisfy it.
